# Local Service Rocket

> Marketing for electricians, with 1:1 business coaching. Local Service Rocket is an electrician marketing company that gets electrical contractors booked jobs from Google (Local Services Ads, Google Ads, electrician SEO and websites) and coaches owners on the systems and decisions that come with scaling. The goal: an electrical shop you are proud to own, and can sell when you are ready.

Founded and run by Alistair St Pierre (Wellington, New Zealand), serving electrical contractors in the US, plus Australia and New Zealand. Month to month, no contracts, no sales calls. Rated 5.0 on Google. Clients have added over $10M in new revenue.

## Services

- [Electrician Marketing Services](https://www.localservicerocket.com/services): All six services, run as one system with 1:1 coaching.
- [Electrician Advertising](https://www.localservicerocket.com/services/electrician-advertising): Google Local Services Ads first (pay per lead), then Google Search ads. Judged on booked jobs, not clicks.
- [Electrician SEO](https://www.localservicerocket.com/services/electrician-seo): Google Business Profile, reviews and local SEO to get electricians into the Google map pack.
- [Electrician Websites](https://www.localservicerocket.com/services/electrician-websites): Fast electrician websites planned around what homeowners search. You own it outright.
- [Hiring Electricians](https://www.localservicerocket.com/services/hiring-electricians): Facebook job ads and skills screening. Most owners are interviewing electricians within about 10 days.
- [Electrician Branding](https://www.localservicerocket.com/services/electrician-branding): Logo, van wraps and uniforms a homeowner reads at 40mph.
- [Electrician Lead Tracking](https://www.localservicerocket.com/services/electrician-lead-tracking): Tracking marketing by booked jobs and revenue, not lead counts.

## Pricing

Every price is public. Full detail: [Flight Plan](https://www.localservicerocket.com/flight-plan) and [Get Started](https://www.localservicerocket.com/get-started).

- Pre-flight ($0-25k months): from $500/month. Includes Google Business Profile fixed, website (if needed), Local Services Ads setup and 1:1 coaching. Plus $25 per booked estimate, only when it books. Aim: 1-3 booked estimates a day and $25k+ months.
- Liftoff: $1,500/month plus ad spend (around $50/day, paid to Google). Optional branding $5k. Aim: $100k months on leads you own, not rent.
- Orbit: 20% of ad spend plus $1,500/month. Hiring sprints $500 setup plus $500/month. Aim: a crew that runs without you and a shop you can sell.

## Electrician case studies

- [Rewired](https://www.localservicerocket.com/case-studies/rewired): Des Moines electrician. $60k to $220k+ average monthly revenue, crew 5 to 12, booked calls 1.5 to 6 a day, after a dozen marketing agencies failed.
- [Honest Hank's](https://www.localservicerocket.com/case-studies/honest-hanks): Tampa electrician. $25k to $80k months, starting from a ~$500 LSA setup.
- [Hooked Up Electric](https://www.localservicerocket.com/case-studies/hooked-up): 1 to 4 counties, 100-200 Google leads a month on Local Services Ads for 2+ years.
- [All case studies](https://www.localservicerocket.com/case-studies)
